instructions_exact: Unpack and assemble MiniMo burner, and add 1 cup of water.
Light MiniMo burner, and add 1/2 cup of quinoa.
Stir and bring to a boil, then lower the temperature to a simmer, cover with lid and cook for 15 minutes.
Add 1/2 cup of unsweetened coconut milk, 1 handful of dried fruit, 2 tbsp of pumpkin seeds, 1 handful of coconut chips, and 2 tbsp of honey.
